answer: Yes, CVS Health reported significant ongoing legal matters in its 2022, 2021, and 2020 10-K filings under Commitments and Contingencies. Most notably, these included extensive opioid-related litigation and government investigations (such as MDL No. 2804 In re National Prescription Opiate Litigation and DOJ/DEA subpoenas), leading to pre-tax charges of $5.2 billion in Q3 2022 and $99 million in Q4 2022 as settlement of opioid claims became probable. Other ongoing matters included Usual and Customary Pricing litigation, securities/ERISA class actions, and prescription processing investigations.
rationale: CVS Health's 10-K describes major ongoing legal proceedings, notably opioid-related litigation and investigations across 2020, 2021, and 2022, resulting in multibillion-dollar financial statement charges.
